n: Smooth again: the reactor, world pictures and tree sap are back to full 60 fps (0.18.1 had slowed some of them to 30, which looked laggy)
Fast screens: on 120 Hz and up the game draws every 2nd or 4th refresh, evenly spaced, so motion stays smooth with no stutter. 60 to 100 Hz screens draw every refresh
Starts about a second faster: the loading screen no longer pauses on each step
World pictures are cheaper to draw at full speed: parts that never change (the nebula, the black hole's centre, galaxy star positions) are worked out once. Nothing looks different
